data.cultural_impact: The name Schuyler holds a significant cultural impact, particularly in American history. One of its most famous bearers is Alexander Hamilton, who used the name Schuyler as a last name when he married Elizabeth Schuyler, scion of the prominent Schuyler family of Albany, New York. The Schuyler family played an essential role in American history, with many members serving in the Continental Army during the American Revolution. Additionally, Eliza Schuyler, the wife of Alexander Hamilton, composed revivalist hymns, such as "Let Us Sing with All Our Hearts," which became popular during the Second Great Awakening and continue to be sung in various Christian denominations today.

During the era when many Schuylers, including Elizabeth, were prominent, religious values were deeply ingrained in American life, particularly in the Albany area.
